query: Official current French sources for radiation oncology fundamentals: SFPM ASN ASNR IRSN HAS INCa radiotherapy physics dosimetry quality assurance radiation protection prescription contouring IGRT brachytherapy proton therapy stereotactic radiotherapy reirradiation adaptive radiotherapy AI. Prefer freely accessible official PDF or authoritative page; give exact title, version/date, URL, issuing body, access status, and which competency it supports.

Official current European and international sources for radiation oncology fundamentals: ESTRO ACROP IAEA ICRU IEC European Commission radiobiology fractionation radiation physics dosimetry treatment planning DVH contouring IGRT motion management SRS SBRT brachytherapy proton therapy radioprotection quality safety toxicity combinations reirradiation adaptive radiotherapy AI. Prefer authoritative accessible documents and identify paywalled standards without bypassing access.
response:
Official current European and international sources for radiation oncology fundamentals encompass consensus guidelines, technical reports, and regulatory frameworks published by key organizations. These include the **European Society for Radiotherapy and Oncology (ESTRO)** and its Advisory Committee for Radiation Oncology Practice (**ACROP**), the **International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)**, the **International Commission on Radiation Units and Measurements (ICRU)**, the **International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC)**, and the **European Commission (EC)**.

Below is an organized mapping of these authoritative sources across core radiation oncology domains, explicitly distinguishing primary reference documents from secondary consensus updates, and noting paywalled standard bodies.

---

### 1. General Physics, Dosimetry, and Units
*   **ICRU Reports (Primary Standards):** 
    *   *ICRU Report 85*: Fundamental quantities and units for ionizing radiation [1].
    *   *ICRU Report 83*: Prescribing, Recording, and Reporting Photon-Beam Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy (IMRT) – defining concepts for absorbed dose, Dose-Volume Histograms (DVH), and structural delineation [2].
*   **IAEA Human Health Reports & Technical Reports Series (TRS) (Primary/Open-Access Guidance):**
    *   *IAEA TRS 398*: Absorbed Dose Determination in External Beam Radiotherapy (the international code of practice for dosimetry based on standards absorbed dose to water) [3].
    *   *IAEA Human Health Reports No. 17*: Commissioning and Quality Assurance of Computerized Planning Systems for Radiation Treatment of Cancer [4].

### 2. Radiobiology, Fractionation, and Toxicity
*   **ESTRO / ACROP & Radiobiological Foundations:**
    *   ESTRO’s targeted educational frameworks and ACROP consensus documents regularly update clinical radiobiology translation (e.g., linear-quadratic model applications, normal tissue complication probability [NTCP] modeling) [5]. 
    *   *QUANTEC / EORTC / ESTRO reviews*: Quantitative Analysis of Normal Tissue Effects in the Clinic (QUANTEC) serves as the standard reference for normal tissue dose-volume toxicity limits, augmented by European expert consensus publications in *Radiotherapy and Oncology* (The Green Journal) [6].

### 3. Contouring, Treatment Planning, and DVH
*   **ICRU & ESTRO ACROP Delineation Guidelines (Primary Consensus):**
    *   *ICRU Report 62 & 83*: Standardization of Gross Tumor Volume (GTV), Clinical Target Volume (CTV), Internal Target Volume (ITV), and Planning Target Volume (PTV) [2, 7].
    *   *ESTRO ACROP Contouring Series*: Site-specific consensus guidelines published open-access or via peer review in *Radiotherapy and Oncology*, covering targets such as head and neck, skull base tumors, thoracic malignancies (e.g., small-cell lung cancer), breast cancer, and prostate recurrences [1, 8, 9].

### 4. Image-Guided Radiation Therapy (IGRT) & Motion Management
*   **ESTRO ACROP Recommendations:**
    *   *ESTRO-ACROP Guideline on Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT)*: Detailed protocols for procurement, acceptance, commissioning, and quality assurance of SGRT systems [10].
    *   *ESTRO ACROP Consensus Guidelines for IGRT*: Site-specific implementation (e.g., localized prostate cancer IGRT action levels and margins) [11].
    *   *Motion Management*: IAEA and ESTRO guidelines on 4D-CT acquisition, internal target volume management, and respiratory gating [12].

### 5. Advanced Techniques: SRS, SBRT, Brachytherapy, and Proton Therapy
*   **Stereotactic Radiosurgery (SRS) & Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy (SBRT):**
    *   *ESTRO ACROP SBRT Implementation Guidelines*: Multi-site standards (e.g., early-stage non-small cell lung cancer, liver metastases) covering immobilization, planning constraints, and quality assurance [13].
*   **Brachytherapy:**
    *   *GEC-ESTRO / ACROP Recommendations*: Disease-specific guidelines (e.g., gynecological malignancies, prostate brachytherapy, and bladder-sparing treatments) detailing image-guided 3D-adaptive brachytherapy workflows [14].
*   **Proton and Particle Therapy:**
    *   *ICRU Report 78*: Prescribing, Recording, and Reporting Proton-Beam Therapy [15].
    *   *IAEA / ESTRO Particle Therapy Guidance*: International frameworks on range verification, robust optimization, and quality assurance for particle facilities.

### 6. Radioprotection, Quality, Safety, and Legal Frameworks
*   **European Commission (EC) Directives (Regulatory / Legal Standards):**
    *   *Council Directive 2013/59/Euratom*: Lays down basic safety standards for protection against the dangers arising from exposure to ionising radiation, directly governing medical exposures across EU member states [16].
    *   *European Commission Guidelines on Medical Physics Expert (MPE)*: Guidelines on safe practices, responsibilities, and education for MPEs in radiotherapy.
*   **International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) Standards (Paywalled / Proprietary Technical Standards):**
    *   *IEC 60601 series* (Medical electrical equipment safety) and *IEC 62046 / specific medical device standards*: Regulate hardware safety, interlocks, and performance specifications for linear accelerators and treatment units (accessible via the [IEC Webstore](https://www.iec.ch), paywalled/subscription-based).

### 7. Reirradiation, Combinations, Adaptive Radiotherapy, and AI
*   **Emerging ESTRO ACROP Consensus:**
    *   *Online MRI-Guided Radiotherapy*: ESTRO-ACROP guideline on quality assurance and medical physics commissioning of online MRI-guided radiotherapy systems based on consensus expert opinion [17].
    *   *Reirradiation & Combinations*: ESTRO-ACROP consensus reports addressing systemic agent combinations (e.g., evidence-based use of androgen deprivation therapy with external beam radiotherapy) [18] and cumulative biological dose constraints for reirradiation scenarios.
    *   *Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Radiotherapy*: ESTRO reports and scientific statements addressing the validation, commissioning, and regulatory hurdles of auto-segmentation and AI-driven adaptive workflows.

---

### Access & Verification Note
*   **Open-Access / Institutional Repositories:** Guidelines published by ESTRO/ACROP frequently feature open-access status in *Radiotherapy and Oncology* (The Green Journal) or via PubMed Central (PMC). IAEA technical reports and human health reports are freely downloadable via the [IAEA Publications Web Shop](https://www.iaea.org/publications).
*   **Paywalled Standards:** Full text standards from the **IEC** (International Electrotechnical Commission) and specific proprietary technical protocols are strictly paywalled on official publisher platforms and require institutional or individual subscription [19].

citations.snippet:
Background and purpose: There is no consensus concerning the appropriate use of androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) during primary and postoperative external-beam radiotherapy (EBRT) in the management of prostate cancer (PCa). Thus, the European Society for Radiotherapy and Oncology (ESTRO) Advisory Committee for Radiation Oncology Practice (ACROP) guidelines seeks to present current recommendations for the clinical use of ADT in the various indications of EBRT. Material and methods: A literature search was conducted in MEDLINE PubMed that evaluated EBRT and ADT in prostate cancer. The search focused on randomized, Phase II and III trials published in English from January 2000 to May 2022. Advisory Committees Actions

response:
Official and authoritative French (INCa, HAS, Santé publique France) and European (ESMO) sources covering fundamental general oncology education and clinical management frameworks are structured below. 

To ensure precision, sources are classified as **Primary** (direct regulatory guidance, national cancer plans, evidence-based clinical practice guidelines, and educational competency frameworks issued by the bodies themselves) or **Secondary** (structured synopses, professional society adaptations, or accredited training curriculums referencing these bodies).

### 1. Institutional Frameworks, Epidemiology, and Public Health
*   **Issuing Body:** Santé publique France (SpF)
*   **Exact Title:** *Cancers : données générales, incidence et mortalité* (Epidemiological surveillance and reports)

*   **Issuing Body:** Institut National du Cancer (INCa)

Gepersonaliseerde geneeskunde & Oncologie
Dit onderzoek integreert moleculaire profilering en geavanceerde beeldvorming om gepersonaliseerde diagnostiek en behandelingen mogelijk te maken. Zo dragen we bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van kankerzorg en precisiegeneeskunde, gebaseerd op patiëntspecifieke inzichten.
LCRC PIs
|Ruth Achten * * Biomarker-gebaseerde diagnostiek voor longkanker
Jill Meynen (LCRC PhD – UHasselt/ZOL) Dit doctoraatsonderzoek bestudeert hoe metabole biomarkers de diagnostische precisie van PET-CT-scans kunnen verbeteren bij patiënten met solitaire longnoduli. Het project evalueert of plasmaglutamaat kan bijdragen aan het onderscheid tussen goedaardige en kwaadaardige longletsels, met als doel een snellere en meer accurate
